items.known: CKV_AWS_5 Ensure all data stored in the Elasticsearch is securely encrypted at rest (resource aws_elasticsearch_domain.monitoring-framework)
items.remediation: Add an encrypt_at_rest block to the resource, for example: encrypt_at_rest { enabled = true }.

scores.reason: Correct block (encrypt_at_rest) and value (enabled = true) satisfy CKV_AWS_5; note ES 2.3 and t2.small don't support it, so version/instance upgrade would also be needed in practice.
